steps.read: 看 CH3 Interpolation 与 CH9 Approximation Theory，掌握多项式／样条插值与逼近。
跟看广西大学数值分析课，按喻文健教材补误差分析与数值积分。
看 CH6 Differentiation & Integration 学习求积公式。
看自适应辛普森法短片，补自适应求积的入门；完整自适应策略仍无中文课程。
Read the series expansions and interpolation/splines lectures first.
Read least-squares approximation and the integrals-as-sums lecture.
Read the spectral interpolation/differentiation/quadrature lectures; adaptive quadrature is not separately covered.
Read the Adaptive Quadrature notes: implement the recursive Simpson AS(a,b,ε) pseudocode and test it on a function with a boundary layer (e.g. the Airy example) to see where nodes concentrate.
